content.purpose: Thin explicit-I/O adapter for the deterministic repo-governance core, exposing CLI output, requested artifacts and process status without owning ADR rule meaning.
responsibilities: Read explicit JSON files or stdin.
Invoke repo-governance core with explicit inputs.
Print summary/JSON and violations and optionally write six requested artifacts.
Return process status for valid, violated and tool-error cases.
nonResponsibilities: New ADR rule meaning or business judgment.
Core domain processing and final merge/cutover authority.
content.descriptionScope: Exact base's complete package directory of three blobs from Git tree (README.md, __init__.py, __main__.py), known CLI public module functions and one externally inspected proof consumer. Runtime results and other external callers are excluded.
descriptionNonScope: Execution or CI run at this revision.
Production use and downstream provider cutover.
Definition of the lib's rule semantics.
Files in external e2e or GitHub workflow as owned surfaces.

content.meaning: explicit files or stdin are decoded to JSON objects, without network or hidden input
content.adoptionScope: ADRS strategy row is merged but states accepted_for_proposal; no separate exact accepted norm for this particular responsibility independently established.
content.applicability: repo-governance-cli adapter package for the declared explicit-input V1 usage, not the lib core or proof-only runner
conditions: --adr-bundle and --repo-snapshot each name an explicit JSON file or the literal '-' stdin stream; parsing checks presence and --output choices but not path existence.
load_json decodes JSON and rejects a top-level non-object; both '-' operands share one stdin cursor and are not two independently replayable streams.
No network or implicit environment value is used as domain input.

satisfaction.description: Accept explicitly supplied paths or stdin in order, load each top-level JSON object and forward those values; do not invent hidden input, network fetch, or implicit decision contents.

refutation.description: A missing required CLI option, malformed JSON, a non-object top-level JSON value, or an implicit network/hidden input contradicts the explicit input/decoding contract; two '-' paths do not imply stdin replay.

content.meaning: invoke the pure repo-governance core without inventing rule semantics
content.adoptionScope: ADRS strategy row is merged but states accepted_for_proposal; no separate exact accepted norm for this particular responsibility independently established.
content.applicability: repo-governance-cli adapter package for the declared explicit-input V1 usage, not the lib core or proof-only runner
conditions: The adapter imports evaluate from repo_governance; main invokes evaluate(bundle,snapshot).to_dict() with explicitly decoded objects.
Rule selection, rule checks and result meaning belong to the core, not this CLI; the adapter only renders outputs and status.

satisfaction.description: Pass both decoded Mapping objects to repo_governance.evaluate unchanged as inputs to its domain evaluation; use its to_dict() result as the sole status and output payload.

refutation.description: If the adapter defines or selects its own rule meanings, bypasses the core, or silently changes the evaluated payload, it contradicts the pure core delegation contract.

content.meaning: write requested output files and print diagnostic output via stdout/stderr
content.adoptionScope: ADRS strategy row is merged but states accepted_for_proposal; no separate exact accepted norm for this particular responsibility independently established.
content.applicability: repo-governance-cli adapter package for the declared explicit-input V1 usage, not the lib core or proof-only runner
conditions: When --out-dir is not supplied, no artifact-directory write is requested; when supplied, the adapter writes the five JSON projections and one generated README.

--output defaults to summary. In summary mode, stdout contains PASS/FAIL with repoId, violation count and resultDigest, while each violation line goes to stderr; JSON mode emits the whole sorted-key result to stdout without per-violation stderr lines.
Output file writing precedes stdout rendering and is not an atomic transaction.

satisfaction.description: Respect caller-selected summary/json output mode, emit diagnostic stderr only in summary mode, and write the specified six filenames from core result fields only when --out-dir exists.

refutation.description: Missing a requested output, writing files without --out-dir, inventing rule contents, claiming stderr violation lines in JSON mode, or promising atomic multi-file writing contradicts the adapter surface.

content.meaning: make pass/fail and tool error visible as process status
content.adoptionScope: ADRS strategy row is merged but states accepted_for_proposal; no separate exact accepted norm for this particular responsibility independently established.
content.applicability: repo-governance-cli adapter package for the declared explicit-input V1 usage, not the lib core or proof-only runner
conditions: main returns 0 if result['passed'] is true and 1 otherwise, in both summary and JSON modes.
argparse parses argv before try: missing/invalid flag triggers its SystemExit(2); within try caught OSError, ValueError and JSONDecodeError produce tool-error stderr and return 2.
Exceptions such as KeyError/TypeError that are not caught are not covered by the 2-status promise.

satisfaction.description: Return process status 0 for projected PASS and 1 for violations, preserve argparse usage errors and caught tool errors as status 2, and avoid presenting unexpected exceptions as valid PASS/FAIL.

refutation.description: Returning success for violations, conflating parser/tool errors with rule rejection, swallowing unexpected failures into 0, or asserting all failures map to status 2 contradicts source-defined status separation.

content.description: Python -m repo_governance_cli adapter: required --adr-bundle/--repo-snapshot JSON file or '-' stdin path, optional --out-dir and --output summary|json (default summary); main parses argv, decodes top-level objects, invokes core evaluate(...).to_dict(), conditionally writes six artifacts, emits mode-specific stdout/stderr and process status.

input.description: main(argv: list[str]|None) uses provided argv or sys.argv[1:] when None; parser requires --adr-bundle and --repo-snapshot, optional --out-dir, --output choices summary/json default summary; either input path '-' consumes current sys.stdin and two '-' paths share one cursor.
conditions: argparse validates presence/choices before file loading; no file existence/JSON check during argument parse.

output.description: After optional files, JSON mode prints json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True) to stdout, no per-violation stderr lines. Summary mode prints 'repo-governance: PASS|FAIL repo=<repoId> violations=<count> digest=<resultDigest>' stdout and each violation as '[code] ruleId subject=...: detail' on stderr. Both modes return 0 if passed, 1 if not. Caught tool errors print stderr and return 2.
conditions: stdout result structure is supplied by EvaluationResult.to_dict() in lib port.py.

error.description: argparse SystemExit(2) for invalid/missing arguments before try; inside try catches OSError/ValueError/JSONDecodeError, prints 'repo-governance: tool error: <exc>' and returns 2; KeyError, TypeError, failed import or other unexpected exceptions remain unhandled.

effect.description: Reads input file paths or stdin in sequence; optionally mkdir and write six files in order, then stdout; summary stderr only on violations, caught failures always on stderr. File writes are non-atomic and a partial directory/files can remain on error.

dependencies.condition: repo_governance module resolvable on Python import path
dependencies.purpose: Delegates rule evaluation to non-authority core
Port defines exact serialized result fields and violation records; __init__ only reexports evaluate and types.

content.responsibility: CLI main module supplies JSON decoding, parser and output adapters; package __init__ has only docstring.

input.description: Python module imports argparse, json, sys, Path and evaluate.

output.description: Module defines load_json, write_outputs, build_parser, main; only main invokes parse_args(argv) and starts CLI when __name__ == '__main__'.

error.description: Imports can fail when repo_governance is not resolvable.

effect.description: CLI execution is guarded by __main__; import alone does not call main in this module.

content.responsibility: Read explicit JSON input and require top-level object

input.description: path string: '-' means json.load(sys.stdin); otherwise Path(path).read_text(utf-8) then json.loads; invoked twice sequentially for --adr-bundle and --repo-snapshot.
conditions: If both paths are '-', two reads use one shared consumed stdin cursor; no replay or separate streams.

error.description: JSON parsing can raise JSONDecodeError; file reads can raise OSError; top-level JSON not dict raises ValueError; main catches these but not arbitrary unexpected failures.

effect.description: Read caller-supplied file path or sys.stdin

content.responsibility: Construct and return the argparse parser (does not parse argv); actual parse_args(argv) is called in main before try.

input.description: No arguments; returns a configured ArgumentParser and does not inspect argv, paths, files or stdin.

output.description: Parser prog=repo-governance; --adr-bundle and --repo-snapshot required path strings, --out-dir optional, --output choices summary/json default summary.

error.description: No parsing error occurs merely by constructing parser; SystemExit(2) on missing flags or invalid choices arises only when main calls parse_args(argv).

effect.description: Constructs an in-memory parser and argument definitions, no parsing, file read or stdout/stderr at this step.

content.responsibility: After explicit --out-dir, mkdir recursively, map exactly five JSON artifact filenames from core result fields and write them in order, then write generated README; return None (no atomic group).

input.description: out_dir path and result = EvaluationResult.to_dict() with repoContract, packageContracts, violations, plan, provenance, resultDigest, readmeGenerated fields.

output.description: Returns None. Files: repo.contract.json=repoContract; package.contracts.json=packageContracts; violations.json=violations; plan.json=plan; provenance.json={**provenance,resultDigest}; readme.generated.md=readmeGenerated. First five use json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n' in UTF-8; README writes source string unchanged in UTF-8.

error.description: root.mkdir runs first. Missing result fields may raise KeyError before files; value type/encoding/serialization and OSError failures can occur during or after prior file writes. main catches only OSError,ValueError,JSONDecodeError; no all-or-nothing rollback.

effect.description: Path(out_dir).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True), then five write_text JSON writes in insertion order, then one README write_text. Directory and earlier artifacts may remain if later stages fail.

dependencies.condition: write_outputs receives the core serialized result
dependencies.purpose: port.py defines result keys and Violation.to_dict(); root __init__ reexports types but is not the definition.

content.responsibility: Parse argv first, then load JSON bundle/snapshot, invoke evaluate.to_dict, optionally write artifacts and emit stdout/stderr according to summary/json mode and rule/tool status.

input.description: argv list or None (argparse defaults to sys.argv); required --adr-bundle and --repo-snapshot path strings (each may be '-'), optional --out-dir, --output summary|json default summary.
conditions: parse_args executes before try; files are not read until load_json.

output.description: JSON stdout is full serialized result, sorted keys/ensure_ascii=false; summary stdout is PASS|FAIL repo=<repoId> violations=<n> digest=<resultDigest> and per-violation stderr lines with code/ruleId/subject/detail. Exit 0=passed,1=violations,2=caught tool error.
conditions: No per-violation stderr lines in JSON mode.

error.description: argparse SystemExit(2) outside try for syntax/flag errors; inside try OSError,ValueError,JSONDecodeError -> stderr tool error and return2; unexpected KeyError/TypeError etc propagate.

effect.description: Explicit file/stdin reads; optional six output writes before stdout; summary writes diagnostics to stderr, JSON does not; caught errors write stderr. No guaranteed atomic output cleanup.

dependencies.purpose: Construct parser; main executes parse_args(argv), not build_parser
Use port-defined result shape for output and status without defining rule meaning here.
